# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

No additional fixes were applied in this Apply Fixes stage. The latest review approved the explicit chemistry-budget and residual carbon-guard work without any actionable amendments for this bead; the only follow-up item was an unrelated `hatch_produces_juveniles` failure attributed to later shrimp-metabolism beads, so the budget-ledger implementation remains unchanged.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Reviewed the latest validation output and confirmed the review approved this bead's budget-ledger work with no required amendments.
2. [Completed] Verified that the only follow-up item was an unrelated `shrimp_population` regression owned by later beads, so no code or documentation edits were necessary for this task.
3. [Skipped] Rerun validation after applying fixes.

## Validation Evidence

- Review outcome was `approved` with no follow-up amendments for this bead's scope.
- No new validation commands were run in this stage because no code changed.
- The latest review recorded `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_tracking` passing on HEAD (18 tests).
- The latest review recorded `cargo clippy -p tank_core -- -D warnings` passing on HEAD.
- The latest review also documented that the remaining `hatch_produces_juveniles` failure is pre-existing on HEAD and attributed to later shrimp-metabolism beads rather than this budget-ledger work.

## Outstanding Risks

- The structural canonical-helper coverage guard is still convention-based rather than reflective; future explicit N/C-bearing fields with non-standard names or fields hidden in empty-by-default collections will require extending the discovery rules and tests.
- Complex multi-process stages such as `system:nitrogen_cycle` still rely on snapshot-derived gross component budgets, so same-component turnover inside a single pass can remain collapsed until those stages emit fully explicit source/sink deltas.
- Shrimp eggs remain implicit until hatch; mass is conserved by debiting dissolved pools on hatch and maturation, but a future phase may still want an explicit egg or clutch biomass pool for clearer persistence and tracing.
- The branch currently has an unrelated `hatch_produces_juveniles` failure on HEAD tied to later shrimp-metabolism work, so full-suite cleanliness depends on that separate bead being resolved.
